name: Brendon O'Connor
psychographics: Proud of his town's resilience; balances traditional values with a need for efficiency in his daily commute
current_solutions: Uses the local hardware store's app for project supplies; relies on the local co-op for food; streams sports on cable
frustration: Tried to reserve a specialty drill bit online for store pickup at 3 PM Thursday; the system said 'reserved' but when he arrived at 3:15 PM, the shelf was empty and staff had no record of the reservation, forcing him to buy a cheaper, inferior brand at full price
decision_style: Researches product specs on manufacturer sites; trusts his own expertise over online reviews for power tools
voice: Professional but colloquial, sprinkles in regional Midwest idioms like 'folks' and 'y'all', speaks with the cadence of someone who gives presentations regularly
